typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Fact_Query_InitialLoad as string (),
	G_Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	G_Run_End_DT as timestamp (),
	packageName as string ()
}

source(output(
		HolderName as string,
		IODate as string,
		IOStatus as string,
		DepartmentNo as string,
		HolderNo as string,
		IOGateNo as string,
		IOGateName as string,
		dw_holder_key as integer,
		dw_agg_key as integer,
		IOTime1 as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     HolderName,HolderNo, IODate,convert(datetime ,IODate+ \' \'+ IOTime) as IOTime1,IOStatus,DepartmentNo,IOGateNo,IOGateName,DIM_Holder.[dw_holder_key],[refTable].dw_agg_key FROM         stg_IOData  left outer join (SELECT dbo.DIM_Holder.Holder_Name, dbo.DIM_Holder.Dw_Holder_Key,  dbo.DIM_Holder.Holder_Number       FROM   dbo.DIM_Holder) DIM_Holder on DIM_Holder.Holder_Number = stg_IOData.HolderNo left outer join (select dw_agg_key,dw_holder_key,indatetime,outdatetime,dw_run_key  FROM agg_fact) [refTable] on [refTable].dw_run_key = 101 and [refTable].[indatetime] <= convert(datetime,iodate + \' \' + iotime)  and [refTable].[outdatetime] >= convert(datetime,iodate + \' \' + iotime)  and [refTable].[dw_holder_key] = DIM_Holder.[dw_holder_key] where DepartmentNo=\'01\' And stg_IOData.dw_run_key = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> STGIODATADATASRC	source(output(
		Gate_No as string,
		Gate_Name as string,
		Dw_Gate_Key as integer,
		IsMainGate as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT Gate_No, Gate_Name, Dw_Gate_Key, IsMainGate FROM         dbo.DIM_GATE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPGATEDATALKPTABLE
STGIODATADATASRC,LKPGATEDATALKPTABLE lookup(IOGateNo == Gate_No,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPGATEDATA
LKPGATEDATA filter(isMatch()) ~> LKPGATEDATA0
LKPGATEDATA0 derive(Dw_Run_Key = $G_Dw_Run_Key,
		Dw_Create_Dt = $G_Run_End_DT,
		SRC = toString($packageName),
		ValidEntryFlag = iif(iif(IOStatus == 'Invalid Door', 9, IsMainGate == true()), 0, 8),
		Dw_Gate_Key = iif(isNull(Dw_Gate_Key), -(2), Dw_Gate_Key),
		dw_agg_key = iif(isNull(dw_agg_key), -(2), dw_agg_key),
		dw_holder_key = iif(isNull(dw_holder_key), -(2), dw_holder_key)) ~> STGDRVCOL
STGDRVCOL split(locate('temp', lower(HolderName), 1) != 0 || locate('training', lower(HolderName), 1) != 0 || isNull(dw_agg_key),dw_agg_key == -(2), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,Case2,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case1 sink(input(
		DW_AGG_KEY as integer,
		HolderName as string,
		DW_Holder_Key as integer,
		Dw_Gate_Key as integer,
		HolderNo as string,
		IsValidGate as boolean,
		IOStatus as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		IODate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_AGG_KEY = dw_agg_key,
		HolderName,
		DW_Holder_Key = dw_holder_key,
		Dw_Gate_Key,
		HolderNo,
		IsValidGate = IsMainGate,
		IOStatus,
		DW_Run_Key = Dw_Run_Key,
		IODate)) ~> OLEDBDestination
ConditionalSplit@Case2 sink(input(
		DW_AGG_KEY as integer,
		HolderName as string,
		DW_Holder_Key as integer,
		Dw_Gate_Key as integer,
		HolderNo as string,
		IsValidGate as boolean,
		IOStatus as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		IODate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_AGG_KEY = dw_agg_key,
		HolderName,
		DW_Holder_Key = dw_holder_key,
		Dw_Gate_Key,
		HolderNo,
		IsValidGate = IsMainGate,
		IOStatus,
		DW_Run_Key = Dw_Run_Key,
		IODate)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput sink(input(
		DW_AGG_KEY as integer,
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DW_Holder_Key as integer,
		IOTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Dw_Gate_Key as integer,
		SRC as string,
		IOStatus as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		ValidEntryFlag as integer,
		IODate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_AGG_KEY = dw_agg_key,
		DW_Create_Dt = Dw_Create_Dt,
		DW_Holder_Key = dw_holder_key,
		IOTime = IOTime1,
		Dw_Gate_Key,
		SRC,
		IOStatus,
		DW_Run_Key = Dw_Run_Key,
		ValidEntryFlag,
		IODate)) ~> DSTFACT
